review_candidates.title: Manager - Compensation & Benefits, Egypt.Egypt- PR&PR - Overseas (Egypt).People & Intellectual Capital Group-MBEGP
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Manage the review, implementation and ongoing administration of compensation, benefits and related people policies for Egypt, under guidance from Group Rewards, ensuring market competitiveness, regulatory compliance, operational effectiveness and alignment with Group Rewards frameworks. The job holder should ensure the following job responsibilities: - Manage the implementation and continuous improvement of compensation and rewards processes and systems for Egypt, ensuring timely execution, data
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: - Review and recommend Egypt benefits policies and programs under guidance from Group Rewards, ensuring market competitiveness, cost effectiveness, employee relevance and compliance with applicable labor and regulatory requirements. - Ensure Egypt compensation and benefits practices comply with applicable labor law, social insurance, tax, regulatory and internal governance requirements, escalating risks and recommending corrective actions where required.
